reply_text:
Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. That's Central time, which matches the channel timestamps. Your message said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. I posted this answer in a reply to your message in #inc-vtg-hartford.

What the guard was doing, going by the channel:
- **10:42:** Writing trailer numbers on a clipboard as a manual fallback, per your report.
- **10:44:** Mateo said six trucks were waiting at the east gate.
- **11:03:** Mateo said kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see.
- **11:07:** You confirmed both lanes were working. You posted that at 11:08.

The channel doesn't say what the guard did between 10:44 and 11:03. It also doesn't say whether the clipboard entries were entered into the system afterward. Mateo or the plant would need to confirm both.
